text:
maya: FYI helm upgrade for model-serving v2 failed in eu-west-1, pre-upgrade hook is stuck waiting on PVC deletion. Gitops can't reconcile the release :grimacing:

leo: ugh, which hook? the one that cleans up detached PVs? can you paste the release output?

maya: deploy-bot posted this in the pipeline: 

deploy-bot: Release model-serving-v2 failed: pre-upgrade hook 'pre-delete-gpu-cache' timed out after 10m. See: https://ci.internal/reports/786

samir: I just ran `kubectl get events -n inference --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 40` and see repeated `PVC deletion blocked by finalizer pvc-protection` 

maya: here's the `kubectl describe pvc` from the pod that was stuck:

```
Name:          model-cache-claim-0
Namespace:     inference
Status:        Terminating
Labels:        app=model-serving
Annotations:   kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: ...
Finalizers:    [kubernetes.io/pvc-protection rbd.csi.ceph.com/finalizer]
Capacity:      100Gi
Access Modes:  RWO
Events:
  Type    Reason                 Age   From                         Message
  ----    ------                 ----  ----                         -------
  Normal  SuccessfulAttachVolume  15m   attachdetach-controller      AttachVolume.Attach succeeded for volume "pvc-1234"
  Warning FailedUnmount           10m   kubelet                      MountVolume.MountDevice failed for volume "pvc-1234": rpc error: code = Internal desc = device is busy
```

julie: looks like the CSI finalizer is stuck because the PV still reports `InUseBy: model-cache-0` even though the pod was deleted by the pre-hook. Probably a race between the hook and the CSI detach controller.

leo: is this specific to eu-west-1? we just upgraded same release in us-west without issues. Could be a node/drain timing difference or old kernel causing detach to hang.

samir: checking node logs now, but short-term we can: 1) remove the problematic finalizer from the PVC (manual) 2) patch the release to skip the pre-delete hook and retry upgrade 3) open issue with CSI vendor for the detach bug. any preferences?

maya: we need a way that doesn't break GitOps: if we manually remove finalizer, argocd will see drift and try to recreate the PVC. But the resource is stuck Terminating so it blocks argocd sync -> stuck app.

julie: proposal: 1) annotate the PVC with `redwood.io/temp-unlocked=true` and remove `kubernetes.io/pvc-protection` finalizer, 2) re-run helm upgrade with `--set hooks.skipPreDelete=true` for this release and let gitops reconcile after. That gives us minimal drift window.

leo: I can do the annotation + finalizer removal if ops OK. Command would be:

```
kubectl annotate pvc model-cache-claim-0 -n inference redwood.io/temp-unlocked=true
kubectl patch pvc model-cache-claim-0 -n inference -p '{"metadata": {"finalizers": []}}' --type=merge
```

samir: prefer to also snapshot the PV before we force-delete, just in case. We have a short retention snapshot class in eu-west, `snap-fast`.

maya: agreed — leo hold on and take a snapshot via CSI plugin or our snapshotter first. After snapshot completes, remove finalizer and trigger helm upgrade with `--set hooks.skipPreDelete=true`. I'll patch the argocd app to allow a short sync override so it doesn't revert the skip flag immediately.

deploy-bot: ci pipeline blocked: waiting on manual approval for upgrade-retry (maya)

julie: post-mortem actions to add: retry/backoff in pre-delete hook, owner refs on PVs so detach isn't racing, and a guard in our GitOps pipeline to auto-escalate when resources are Terminating for >5m.

leo: snapshot finished. proceeding to remove finalizer in 30s. tagging @samir for the PV snapshot ID to store in the incident ticket. :hammer_and_wrench:

samir: got the snapshot id: snap-eu-20260318-01, saved in INC-873.

maya: thanks — once upgrade completes I'll follow up with a short RFC to make pre-delete hooks idempotent and add a `--ha-aware` flag to skip hooks during region-constrained rollouts.

gitops-bot: ArgoCD: application "inference/model-serving" sync status: OutOfSync -> Synced (manual override by maya)

leo: upgrade retried and succeeded, helm release now at v2.1.0. marking incident resolved for now. :white_check_mark:

maya: filing a blameless postmortem and follow-up tickets, will ping eng-releases channel with the RFC link. thanks everyone.
